subject: MAP weekly — stakeholder alignment & landing plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Roberts <amelia.roberts@parallax.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly — stakeholder alignment & landing plan

Hi Amelia / Parallax team,

Thanks again for the sync today. As promised, here is a short status update and a proposed landing plan for the next two weeks so we keep the MAP moving toward close. I've attached an updated MAP workbook (Parallax_MAP_v3.xlsx) with milestones and owners.

Current status (high level):
- Evaluation: PoC has completed basic throughput tests; latency targets met for 2k token queries on g5.
- Security: Parallax requested SOC2 evidence and retention policy details; we have a partial bundle ready.
- Commercial: Commercial SOW draft shared; awaiting your procurement timelines.

Key open items / risks:
1) SOC2 artifact list — Parallax asked for encryption-at-rest evidence and audit-log samples (owner: Neha).
2) Performance benchmark for peak concurrency — Parallax wants worst-case 95th p99 latency at 10 concurrent sessions (owner: Karthik).
3) Commercial timeline — sign-off target for SOW to enable Dedicated early May (owner: Vanessa / Parallax procurement).

Decisions proposed by Redwood:
- If SOC2 artifacts are acceptable, we can start a short compliance review (2–3 business days) and then enable a Private deployment checklist.
- If benchmark 95th/99th latency exceeds threshold, we propose enabling burst capacity for the first 30 days at a reduced rate while we optimize batching.

Action items (see attached MAP for full table):
- Neha: Deliver SOC2 evidence packet + audit log snippet by 2027-04-09. (attachment: SOC2_QA.pdf)
- Karthik: Run 2 additional worst-case concurrency benchmarks, share CSV results by 2027-04-14. (attachment: benchmark_summary.csv)
- Vanessa: Turnaround SOW draft and coordinate with procurement; push for signature by 2027-04-22. (attachment: Draft_SOW_Parallax.docx)

Proposed next-week agenda (short):
1) Review SOC2 artifact acceptance (5–10m)
2) Benchmark results review and gating decision (20m)
3) Commercial milestones and procurement eta (10m)

Can you confirm who from Parallax will own procurement follow-up and whether the 2027-04-22 sign target looks realistic?

Thanks — will update the MAP workbook after I get Neha/Karthik deliverables.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Parallax_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet of milestones/owners)

From: Amelia Roberts <amelia.roberts@parallax.ai>

Cc: Parallax Evaluation <eval-team@parallax.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly — stakeholder alignment & landing plan

Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful. A couple quick notes:

- Procurement owner: I'm the lead on this side for commercial sign (cc'd our procurement alias: eval-team@parallax.ai). Our internal legal review will likely take 5–7 business days once we have the SOW. 4/22 is tentative but possible if we move quickly.
- SOC2: We need the encryption-at-rest controls documentation and a short statement about key management. If Neha can provide the packet by 4/9 that should be fine.
- Benchmarks: We run a separate concurrency test next Tuesday; I want to see the 95th percentile numbers before committing to Dedicated.

I'll plan to join the next sync on Tue 4/12.

Best,
Amelia Roberts
Head of Infrastructure | Parallax AI
amelia.roberts@parallax.ai

Attachment: None

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Amelia Roberts <amelia.roberts@parallax.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly — stakeholder alignment & landing plan

Agree with the approach. Quick commitments from our side:

- I'll execute the 10-concurrency worst-case run on our staging Dedicated cluster and include a p50/p95/p99 CSV export. Owner: Karthik Iyer. ETA: 2027-04-14 EOD. (See attached: benchmark_summary.csv — draft placeholder)
- If p95/p99 are above your target, we'll provision temporary burst capacity for 30 days and apply batching tuning while we iterate.

Question for procurement/Amelia: do you have a preferred format for the SOW? We typically provide a one-page summary + SOW attachment; I can tailor the commercial appendix if necessary.

On the internal ops side, I've flagged a small risk: under certain long-context prompts KV cache growth can add 5–7% CPU per session; we'll include recommendations in the benchmark notes.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: benchmark_summary.csv (will upload final CSV after runs)

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly — stakeholder alignment & landing plan

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Finalizing the MAP items below (decisions, owners, due dates) so we have clear closure from this week's checkpoint.

Decisions (agreed):
- Parallax will review SOC2 packet and provide a yes/no on acceptance by 2027-04-12 EOD. If accepted, Redwood begins compliance review and scheduling for Private deployment prep.
- Redwood will run concurrency benchmarks and share p50/p95/p99 by 2027-04-14 EOD; if p95 exceeds agreed threshold, Redwood will enable burst capacity for the first 30 days.
- SOW: Redwood to send final SOW by 2027-04-13; Parallax procurement aims for signature by 2027-04-22.

Action items (concise):
- Neha (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai): SOC2 packet submitted (done). Follow-up: provide admin-audit raw CSV if Parallax requests it — due 2027-04-13
- Karthik (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai): Run concurrency benchmark; upload final benchmark_summary.csv to shared Drive — due 2027-04-14
- Vanessa (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai): Finalize SOW + send DocuSign link — due 2027-04-13
- Amelia / Parallax Procure: Confirm SOW acceptance timeline and point person for signature — response due 2027-04-12

Next week's proposed agenda (Tue 2027-04-12, 10:00 PT):
1) SOC2 packet decision (5m)
2) Confirm SOW format & signature path (10m)
3) Benchmark check-in and mitigation plan if needed (20m)
4) Quick rollout checklist for first-week Dedicated onboarding (10m)

Logistics: I'll send a short calendar invite for Tue 4/12 10:00 PT and include a link to the MAP workbook in Drive. If any of the owners see a date conflict with deliverables above, reply-all and I'll update the schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping the open items.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Lead | Redwood Inference
